messages.content: 公司XYZ明年的損失預測是多少？

function.name: finance_predict_revenue
function.description: Predict the revenue of a company for a specific period based on historical data and industry trends. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

period.description: The period for which revenue is to be predicted, e.g. next year.

industry_trends.description: Whether to consider industry trends in prediction. Defaults to false.

But we can use it to predict revenue; then maybe compute loss? However, we don't have cost data. There's no mention of asking clarifying question about industry trends. We might assume they want default (false). But we could also ask if they'd like to include industry trends. But the user asked for loss forecast. We can't provide loss directly because we only have revenue prediction. We could respond: "I will predict revenue first." Then call function. After receiving revenue, we could estimate loss? But we lack cost data. We could say: "Based on your request, I will predict revenue for XYZ next year." Then call function. That seems appropriate.

We should call the function with arguments: company_name="XYZ", period="next year". industry_trends unspecified -> defaults to false. We'll produce JSON accordingly.
